# mistral.rs usability cases

Ten source-anchored hard content cases: two root, two per route and two integration. These are assertion specifications, not comparative agent efficacy or executed native tests. Selected source tests remain blocked, not replaced by synthetic cases.

| Case | Target |
| --- | --- |
| root/source-is-not-installed | root |
| root/legacy-is-not-disabled | root |
| sub-skills/decode-contract/packed-scales-and-window | decode-contract |
| sub-skills/decode-contract/scratch-bytes-not-capacity | decode-contract |
| sub-skills/prefill-contract/packed-workspace-versus-total | prefill-contract |
| sub-skills/prefill-contract/offset-mask-and-chunk-precedence | prefill-contract |
| sub-skills/qualification/prepared-inventory-not-parity | qualification |
| sub-skills/qualification/cold-cache-and-embedded-failure | qualification |
| integration/prefill-geometry-is-not-decode | integration |
| integration/warmup-and-flat-formula-not-engine-pass | integration |
